gates.name: Docusaurus production build, run the way docs-ci.yml's verify job actually runs it (pristine ghcr.io/the-running-dev/docs-template:latest, docs-build.ps1 -SourceDocs ./docs against a fresh checkout)
gates.detail:
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd):/workspace:ro" -w /workspace ghcr.io/the-running-dev/docs-template:latest pwsh -File /template/scripts/docs-build.ps1 -SourceDocs ./docs -OutputPath /tmp/artifacts/docs
Overlaying '/workspace/docs' over '/template' ... Building static site ... webpackbar Server: Compiled successfully in 23.50s / Client: Compiled successfully in 44.79s / [SUCCESS] Generated static files in "artifacts". / Copying static site to '/tmp/artifacts/docs' ... Done.
[exited with code 0]. No broken-link errors, including for the changed guide page's added cross-links and Mermaid diagrams.

An earlier local attempt using this repo's own docs.ps1 -BuildOnly wrapper, followed by running the image's 'Invoke-DocsBuild' dispatch command against that already-baked image, failed with 'Docusaurus found broken links!' on every page's link to '/'. Investigated and confirmed a false positive specific to that reproduction path, not a real gate failure: docs.ps1's Dockerfile does `COPY . .` at docker-build time, baking this repo's own docs/src/pages/index.md (a legitimate, repo-authored site-root page) into /template/src/pages. The base image's own docs-build.ps1 (source read directly from the built image at /PSModule/Scripts/docs-build.ps1) then runs a self-described leaked-template-page check before its own overlay step: 'The image excludes src/pages for this reason (see .dockerignore), so finding one here means that exclusion regressed' -- it cannot distinguish a genuine base-image leak from a consumer's own page already baked in by an earlier COPY, so it deletes /template/src/pages, and the second overlay never restores it because -SourceDocs defaults to './docs' (a subdirectory that does not contain src/pages). docs-ci.yml's real 'verify' job never hits this: it runs the *pristine*, un-baked base image directly against a fresh checkout ('/template/scripts/docs-build.ps1 -SourceDocs ./docs'), which is exactly what this corrected run reproduces, and it passed. The docs.ps1 -BuildOnly + Invoke-DocsBuild combination is a bug in the local double-bake reproduction, not in this PR, this repository's docs-ci.yml, or the upstream image.

gates.reason: grep across .github/workflows/*.yml for the literal comment '# verification: true' returns zero matches — this repository has never added the flag to any workflow step, and there is not even a verify.yml workflow file present (only build.yml, docs-ci.yml, docs-deploy.yml, release.yml). This gap is already tracked as issue #131 (/verify's # verification: true flag has never been added to this repository's workflows). Nothing was skipped on judgement here — there was nothing flagged to run.
